title: CodeChallenge: Activation histograms by token length (part 3)

cues.en: Exercise six has an analysis part and a visualization part.

cues.en: The analysis part is pretty straightforward.

cues.zh: 左邊的折線圖，對應 12 個 Transformer 區塊 MLP 層各自的直方圖。

cues.en: and the layer where that line or that histogram comes from.

cues.en: That's why this was commented out in the beginning.
cues.zh: 所以，一開始才把它註解掉。

cues.en: Okay, let's recreate that graph.
cues.zh: 重畫。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So here we see that some features are the same as with the small version of the model.
cues.zh: 這裡有些特徵與小型版本相同。

cues.en: And some features are a little bit different.
cues.zh: 有些稍微不同。

cues.en: So we still do see this uh shift of the first layer, the first transformer block immediately after the token embeddings.
cues.zh: 仍看到第一層，也就是 token 嵌入後第一個 Transformer 區塊的偏移。

cues.en: That one is shifted to the right.
cues.zh: 向右偏。

cues.en: And as I mentioned, you will see repeatedly that lots of the intermediate layers kind of smoothly transition
cues.zh: 就像提過的，你會反覆看到，很多中間層在特性，以及與 token 類別的關係上，

cues.en: from one layer into the next layer in terms of their characteristics and relation to token categories and so on.
cues.zh: 從一層到下一層，平滑轉變。

cues.en: But there tends to be something qualitatively distinct going on in the very first layer, and also in
cues.zh: 但第一層，以及最後一層或最後幾層，

cues.en: the very last or last couple of layers shortly before we get to the selection for the next token in the sequence.
cues.zh: 在即將選取序列下一個 token 之前，往往有定性上不同的情況。

cues.en: And you also don't see exactly quite as clearly.
cues.zh: 這裡看得沒有那麼清楚。

cues.en: Maybe I'll change the upper scaling limit of the color here.
cues.zh: 也許改變色彩尺度上限。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: You do see this pattern a little bit that the later layers still get tighter, their distributions get tighter because the processing is less about the current token.
cues.zh: 還是稍微看得到，後面層的分布變窄，因為處理越來越不關乎目前 token。

cues.en: And it starts to become more abstracted and more about selecting the next token in the sequence.
cues.zh: 開始更抽象，更關乎選取下一個 token。

cues.en: And so actually, yeah, I guess that is a little bit similar to in the smaller version of the model, although this, uh, compression was a little bit tighter and more localized to the later layers.
cues.zh: 所以，對，我想這有點像小型模型，只是那裡的壓縮更窄，而且更集中在後面層。

cues.en: Remember that the concept of token length does not exist inside the model directly.
cues.zh: 記得，token 長度這個概念，不直接存在模型內。

cues.en: That is, models do not process tokens according to how many characters they contain.
cues.zh: 模型不是根據 token 有幾個字元來處理。

cues.en: The model just processes the tokens as integers as vectors of embeddings.
cues.zh: 只把 token 當整數、嵌入向量處理。

cues.en: On the other hand, it is also the case that tokens with fewer characters tend to appear more often
cues.zh: 另一方面，字元較少的 token，往往更常出現在

cues.en: in the training text, so the relationship between activation and token length is probably due to token frequency and not length per se.
cues.zh: 訓練文字中，所以活化與 token 長度的關係，可能來自 token 頻率，而不是長度本身。

cues.en: These kinds of third variable explanations can either be useful interpretations or confounds and flaws
cues.zh: 這種第三變數解釋，可以是有用的解讀，也可以是研究中的混淆與缺陷，

cues.en: in the research, so make sure that you are aware of these possibilities of alternative explanations.
cues.zh: 所以，務必留意這些替代解釋。

cues.en: Nonetheless, it's quite interesting to see that there are some striking qualitative differences across the different layers, but not necessarily across all of the layers.
cues.zh: 不過，很有意思，跨不同層會有一些明顯定性差異，但不是所有層之間都有。

cues.en: So that's a theme that you'll continue observing in mech Interp sometimes you will find that the earliest
cues.zh: 這也是機制可解釋性中，會持續看到的主題；有時最早

cues.en: layers and the latest layers are kind of off doing their own thing, and lots of layers in the middle are strongly correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 與最晚的層，各自做自己的事，中間很多層則高度相關。

cues.en: The last point that I'll make here is about the assumption of universality, which I introduced in the
cues.zh: 最後要提的，是普遍性假設，課程先前

cues.en: videos earlier in the course where I discussed general concepts and criticisms of mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 討論機制可解釋性的一般概念與批評時介紹過。

cues.en: Remember that in this context, universality means that the same principles observed in small models are also present in large models.
cues.zh: 記得，這個脈絡下的普遍性，指小模型中觀察到的相同原則，也存在於大模型。

cues.en: Now, the analysis that you did here in this video were not a definitive case of supporting or disproving that assumption.
cues.zh: 這部影片做的分析，並不是明確支持或推翻那個假設的定論。

cues.en: But you can see that some of the macroscopic characteristics are not necessarily qualitatively the same between small and large models.
cues.zh: 但可以看到，小型與大型模型，某些巨觀特性在定性上不一定相同。

cues.en: Now, it certainly is possible that universality exists for some computational features of models, but not for all features of models.
cues.zh: 當然，也可能某些模型計算特徵有普遍性，但不是所有特徵都有。
